name: dojo-router
description: No subagent silently inherits your most expensive model. Warns or blocks unpinned dispatches; the mod routes them by role.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: What the classic hooks do with a dispatch that names no model: warn (default), block, or off. Does not affect the mod.

default_tier.title: Default tier
default_tier.description: Model alias suggested by the hooks, and filled in by the mod, for unpinned dispatches.

explore_tier.title: Explore tier
explore_tier.description: Model alias suggested or filled in for Explore dispatches.

auto_route.title: Auto-route (mod)
auto_route.description: Mod only: fill in the model on unpinned built-in dispatches. Needs function hooks enabled.

opus_cap.title: Opus cap (mod)
opus_cap.description: Mod only: after this many opus dispatches in a session, unpinned dispatches stop landing on opus: Explore keeps the Explore tier, the rest go to the default tier (sonnet if that is opus). 0 turns the cap off.
